_comment: OTA-232 — ingested verbatim from Arbiter_Assigned_Titles_for_Players.docx. The 20 titles the Arbiter may confer on a player. Stored as lore today (surfaced to Qwen so the Arbiter knows the titles exist and can foreshadow them in narration). A future OTA can wire the requirements to runtime trackers + perks to mechanical effects; this file is the canonical source either way.

titles.title: Seeker of Lost Relics
titles.requirement: Discover three ancient relics
titles.perk: +2 to Investigation when dealing with ancient artifacts.

titles.title: Arcane-Attuned
titles.requirement: Survive a direct encounter with an energy anomaly
titles.perk: Once per day, gain temporary resistance to energy damage for 3 rounds.

titles.title: Protector of the Forgotten
titles.requirement: Successfully defend a settlement from invaders
titles.perk: +1 to Defense when fighting in defense of settlements or relics.

titles.title: Architect's Eye
titles.requirement: Repair or restore a piece of ancient architecture
titles.perk: +2 to Engineering or Repair skills when dealing with ancient structures.

titles.title: Stormbound Survivor
titles.requirement: Survive an energy storm
titles.perk: Once per day, reroll a failed saving throw against environmental hazards.

titles.title: Sidekick Whisperer
titles.requirement: Successfully control an construct
titles.perk: Once per encounter, temporarily disable an construct.

titles.title: Shadow Diver
titles.requirement: Complete three dives into ancient ruins without triggering traps
titles.perk: +1 to Stealth and the ability to bypass one trap per dive.

titles.title: Awakened
titles.requirement: Unlock the latent powers of a latent power
titles.perk: Once per day, activate a powerful energy surge to enhance movement or strength for 2 rounds.

titles.title: Scholar of Forgotten Lore
titles.requirement: Decipher three pieces of ancient text
titles.perk: +2 to Lore or History checks when studying ancient civilizations.

titles.title: Bane of Constructs
titles.requirement: Defeat five constructs
titles.perk: Once per day, deal an extra damage die against mechanical foes.

titles.title: Relic Trader
titles.requirement: Successfully barter or trade five ancient relics
titles.perk: +2 to Persuasion when negotiating trades involving relics.

titles.title: Far Explorer
titles.requirement: Lead an expedition deep into unexplored ancient ruins
titles.perk: +1 to Leadership when guiding a party through ruins or unknown terrain.

titles.title: Scion of the Giants
titles.requirement: Prove direct descent from the the old giants
titles.perk: +2 to Charisma when dealing with factions that respect the old legacy.

titles.title: Survivor of energy stone
titles.requirement: Survive prolonged exposure to energy stone
titles.perk: Gain advantage on Constitution checks against energy corruption or radiation.

titles.title: Wayfarer of the Lost Paths
titles.requirement: Navigate through the a shifting labyrinth without getting lost
titles.perk: Once per day, instantly determine the correct path in a complex environment.

titles.title: Master of Spellcraft
titles.requirement: Successfully create or enhance an construct
titles.perk: Once per encounter, temporarily enhance a summoned construct's abilities.

titles.title: Warden of the Old World
titles.requirement: Preserve an ancient relic or building from destruction
titles.perk: +1 to all Defense rolls when in or around ancient ruins.

titles.title: Speaker of Forgotten Tongues
titles.requirement: Learn to fluently speak the ancient language
titles.perk: Once per session, communicate with ancient machines or relics.

titles.title: Stormcaller
titles.requirement: Survive or navigate through an energy storm and save a party member
titles.perk: Once per day, create a small energy shield that deflects energy attacks.

titles.title: Guild Broker
titles.requirement: Successfully negotiate a truce or alliance between two factions
titles.perk: +1 to Diplomacy and a reroll once per day when brokering peace or deals.
